_help: Short openings of articles from the Canonn Interstellar Research Group archive (https://science.canonn.tech), made by tools/build_canonn_knowledge.py. Credit: Canonn Interstellar Research Group and the authors of the articles. Only the first few sentences are kept; the src field says where the full article is.

entries.a: As we continue our musical exploration of human history, LCU No Fool Like One and Cat V reimagine Estelle and Kanye West's rap/song American Boy from the early 21st Century with their rendition of "Gnosis Megaship Tour" to the tune of the old song. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

11 Parsecs is a bar that may be found in orbit of HIP 110028 6. Two Satellites giving Engineer Data are adjacent to the facility. Contains a Navigation Beacon. The number and type of ships around the area is typical for the system's primary Navigation Beacon. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

An Abandoned SRV can be found in the 34 Virginis system on body 5 a or. The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: Mel 111 Sector BL-O b6-0 / HIP 63386 / Col 285 Sector CI-V b18-0 That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

An Abandoned SRV can be found in the 44 k Virginis system on body B 7 e or. The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: Col 285 Sector IZ-R b20-2 / Col 285 Sector EC-J c10-4 / Col 285 Sector KD-H c11-3 That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Galnets, Community Goals and Further Messages On the 28th August 3311, a social media message was transmitted stating: "A secret to be uncovered. A trail to be followed.", along with a short video clip. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

This research paper by Redden Alt-Mer and factabulous looks at the thorny issue of how the Thargoids are selecting their targets for attack. In 3305 this has been more difficult as there is greater diversity in the selected systems, and has broken assumptions made in earlier times. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

The data in this study has been found to to out of date for the current game A further Brain Tree study by our very own CMDR Maligno It is well known in the community that Brain Trees can grow material nodes that come in four varieties: Cordycep Growth, Polyporous Growth, Mussidaen Seed Pod, and Phloem Excretions. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The Listening Post can be found in the Synuefe XE-Y c17-7 system, around body 3 a. The location matches the description found in the flight of the Adamastor, so it is believed that the Listening Post is related. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The galactic community recently decided to support Zende Partners in the development of an Advanced Multi-Cannon weapon. Given the usual lack of transparency in weapon documentation, the goal of this study was to characterize the Anti-Xeno properties of this newly developed module. That is from the Canonn research archive, under technology.
A Listening Post named "Aegis Statement 3309" can be found in the Luyten's Star system, orbiting body 3. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

With the release of the Odyssey branded software upgrade to the Commanders of the Pilots Federation's fleet of ships, they are now capable of atmospheric flight. That is from the Canonn research archive, under technology.

A Federation Capital Ship dock facility can be found in the Airsetanoa system, in orbit of body 2. It contains one or more Farragut-class Battlecruisers, showing signs of battle damage, undergoing repairs. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Alcatraz Class Prison Ship designation JJF-048 was last reported in orbit of the planet HIP 17692 A 3. The ship is heavily damaged, destroyed by weapons consistent with other Thargoid attacks, leaving green hull scarring and some kind of green gas throughout the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Alcatraz Class Prison Ship designation SSC-852 is expected to be in the following system, based on the last reported flight operations plan: A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Alcatraz-class Reformatory is a class of Prison Ship. The class consists of a very large number of cell block modules; two are mounted at the front along the direction of the ship's axis, with the third in the center of the axis set back. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Extremely hardy photosynthetic organisms that thrive in arid environments. Thick, waxy leaf structures protect them from extreme surroundings, when gaseous exchange becomes unfavourable. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

UPDATE! The hunt is over! With the advent of the galactic Codex CMDRs found tubeworms near the galactic core. These can be found in the in-game Codex classified as Sinuous Tubers in several areas around the Galactic Core sector. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The Alliance Chieftain is a medium size ship manufactured by Lakon Spaceways. It was designed to be sturdy yet maneuverable compared to other ships in its size and weight class making it a common choice for anti-Thargoid combat. That is from the Canonn research archive, under technology.

Ameida Landing is an abandoned settlement in the Conn system, on body A 3 a or. The location of this facility was given by an Unregistered Comms Beacon that can be found in the Teegarden's star system, orbing body 2. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.
A Civilian Installation can be found in orbit of Alpha Centauri B 1. Two Satellites giving Engineer Data are adjacent to the facility. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

A Scientific Installation may be found in orbit of the White Dwarf star Amadioha A. Contains a Navigation Beacon. The number and type of ships around the area is typical for the system's primary Navigation Beacon. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Amaethon-class Cropper is a type of Agricultural Vessel. Around a slim central axis with a single small engine at the rear with the Shiplog Uplink, six huge Cargo Modules build the megaships rear body connected to the central axis. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

These are relatively rare organics, and they will appear on the Navigation panel as Biological signals. There appears to be only a single classification. They spawn the usual range of raw materials, shoot them to retrieve. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

This is a report of some analysis I've been doing this past week. My objective was to answer the following two questions: Is there something special about the abundance of ammonia systems in the Thargoid "bubble" centered around Merope? That is from the Canonn research archive, under exploration.

It has been known for a some time that the spectrogram of the audio from obelisks found in Guardian Ancient Ruins exhibits a series patterns comprised of vertical bars. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

This is a follow up to an in-depth analysis of the data packets found in the Guardian obelisk audio. The details of the data packets were reported, but the most profound result was the histogram of the number of bars seen in all of the extracted data packets. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

The Aquarius-class is a class of Tanker. The class consists of two hub modules surrounded by three long trusses of liquid tanks, and backed by a drive module each. Both sets of tanks are held together side by side by struts, on which a number of cargo containers are also mounted. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Aquarius Class Tanker designation ALF-895 was last reported in orbit of the planet HIP 17225 A 2. The ship is heavily damaged, destroyed by weapons consistent with other Thargoid attacks, leaving green hull scarring and some kind of green gas throughout the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Aquarius Class Tanker designation KGD-684 is expected to be in the following system, based on the last reported flight operations plan: A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

A Aquarius Class Tanker, designation WKS-559, has been attacked by pirates and can be found in the California Sector BA-A e6 system, orbiting body 4. A number of Engineer Materials / Cargo are scattered nearby. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Ariane's Pride is a crashed Type 9 found in the HIP 32001 system on body 3 a. The location of this site can be found by following the two nearby listening posts located in: Mayday…Mayday…This is the trading vessel Ariane's Pride. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There are several varieties of Aster Trees and their associated pods to be found around the galaxy - notably in the Formorian Frontier sector. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

A Scientific Installation can be found in orbit of Atins 1. Contains a Navigation Beacon. The number and type of ships around the area is typical for the systems primary Navigation Beacon. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Incoming transmission from Professor Awan: After reviewing a large number of atmospheres since Odyssey's release, this list is a compilation of some of the most common or exceptional color palettes which I've come across. That is from the Canonn research archive, under exploration.

In late June 3304 a series of surface settlements that had been attacked by Thargoids were discovered. Listening Posts, in groups of three, were found in systems within the Pleiades, often within inhabited systems. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There has been recent success in using rigorous mathematical techniques to accurately estimate the damage partitioning of human weapons, such as Plasma Accelerators and Railguns. That is from the Canonn research archive, under technology.

CMDR Coehoorn has supplied a overview of the Azimuth Saga taken from Galnet Beginning a multi-part overview of historical events surrounding Azimuth Biochemicals and its connection to the mysterious Salvation. That is from the Canonn research archive, under the news.

True unicellular extremophiles capable of living in the full spectrum of temperatures, chemical soups and atmospheres. They form a kaleidoscopic range of patterns and colours based on their method of metabolism. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The Banner Class Bulk Cargo Ship BTG-237 was last reported in orbit of the moon Pleiades Sector IR-W d1-55 5 a. The ship is heavily damaged, destroyed by weapons consistent with other Thargoid attacks, leaving green hull scarring and some kind of green gas throughout the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Banner Class Bulk Cargo Ship designation TIH-562 is expected to be in the following system, based on the last reported flight operations plan: A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Banner-class Hauler is a class of Bulk Cargo Ship. The class consists of a command module on the front, with a cargo pod behind it, followed by a drive module. All four Cargo Bays sit on the cargo pod module as well as four Turrets. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There are a number of locations where barnacles can be found in large numbers. These are know as barnacle forests. Scanning the body with the full spectrum scanner will show that the body has Thargoid signals. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

Large Barnacles are alien life forms that have been found on certain air-less planets of ambient temperature close to nebulae in the Pleiades, Witch Head and Coalsack nebulae. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

Tranquility's Stop maintains a tourist installation in orbit of BD+22 3878 5, a water world within the Dumbbell Nebula. Contains a Navigation Beacon, which will give you the data for the local system, and a number of tourist ships. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Beckett-class Researcher is a type of Science Vessel. It consists of a central Axis with an engine module at the rear, mounting command modules and two rotating habitat rings. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There are several varieties of Bell Molluscs to be found around the galaxy - notably in Temple and Norma Arm. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. Look for the largest concentration of signals inside the phenomena and you should find them as they are small relative to non-organic forms. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The Bellmarsh Class Prison Ship designation DLV-812 is expected to be in the following system, based on the last reported flight operations plan: A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Bellmarsh-class is a class of Prison Ship. The class consists of a very large central seven-engine drive structure, flanked by two detention centers, and topped by a command module that faces perpendicular to the apparent front of the ship. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.
A Comms Installation can be found in orbit of Belu A 1. Contains two Satellites giving Engineer Data. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

This is a crashed Anaconda on Belu B 1. The location of this crash site is provided by scanning the Settlement Comms Log Uplinks at the Unlisted Wreckage Site on Col 285 Sector EP-C b27-3 A 2. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Beluga Liner is a large ship manufactured by Saud Kruger. It was designed as a high-end passenger ship, able to accommodate luxury-tier cabins and carry a vast number of passengers. That is from the Canonn research archive, under technology.

Betterton Outpostis an abandoned settlement that has been attacked by Thargoids in the HIP 19792 system on body C 2 or. The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: The Latitude and Longitude values are flipped. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Botanial Research Station FNA-559 is an abandoned settlement in the Col 285 Sector MZ-N c7-13 system on body AB 1. This site was first reported by Commander RollingSaint. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Bowman Class Science Vessel designation ZZW-101 is expected to be in the following system, based on the last reported flight operations plan: A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Bowman-class is a class of Science Vessel. The class consists of a science module on the front, a long central superstructure with a communications module in the middle, and a drive module on the rear. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

CMDR Maligno once again brings us a research paper on the acoustic features of the Brain Trees. One of the more notable characteristics of Brain Tree sites is the pervasive acoustic signal, which can be heard immediately after dipping below an altitude of approximately 450m above ground level. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

A crashed Eagle can be found at a Crashed Ship POI in the Brokutsu system on body 3 a. The crashed ship has a Ship Data Core that can be scanned for a log, as well as a few various commodities behind it. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Former Executive Producer of Elite Dangerous, Michael Brooks, passed away in June 2023. His memory lives on in all those who play Elite Dangerous and in memorial beacons added in his honor. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There are several varieties of Bulb Molluscs to be found around the galaxy - notably in the Inner Orion-Perseus Conflux sector. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

There are several varieties of Bullet Molluscs to be found around the galaxy - notably in the Outer Orion sector. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. Look for the largest concentration of signals inside the phenomena and you should find them though they are smaller than the non-organic items and can be hard to spot. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

Photosynthetic organisms that have adapted to extreme conditions by reducing their surface area to volume ratio, thereby protecting more sensitive tissues from exposure. The outer layer is formed from specialised light-transmitting cells. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

A number of people have contacted us asking if they can be registered for the Canonn challenge. We saw this as more of a pilgrimage than a race or a competition. It is even something you can do by accident just by bumbling around the galaxy. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

Constructed in 3302 in orbit of Col 285 Sector IX-T d3-43 A 1, the Canonn Institute is a state-of-the-art Scientific Outpost dedicated to support the Canonn Intersteller Research Group's research into the Unknown Artefacts, Unknown Probes, Unknown Ships, and other mysteries of the galaxy. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

On Thursday 19th November 3301 the Galactic Intern, Ed Lewis, joined a bunch of our scientists for a UA hunt and never-before-seen experiment. If you want to know more about us, how it all started and what we get up to - then watch it now! That is from the Canonn research archive, under about Canonn.

Cmdr Content created a expedition to represent Canonn in an HCS Voicepacks competition This route provides 17 destinations rich with the lore of the Galaxy. Most of these destinations focus on our xeno friends, the Thargoids, and our efforts to hide and eradicate them. That is from the Canonn research archive, under the news.

There are several varieties of Capsule Molluscs to be found around the galaxy - notably in the Odin's Hold sector. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. Look for the largest concentration of signals inside the phenomena and you should find them. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

On 29 OCT 3310, a Galnet was released stating that Famed Treasure Hunter Herman Colt had gone missing, whilst searching for the final treasure hoard of Captain Morrigan. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Cargo Vessel Ford Prefect, a Banner Class Bulk Cargo Ship, can be found in orbit of the planet Birmingham in the Gurney Slade system. There are Engineer Materials scattered nearby. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Carmichael Point is an abandoned settlement in the HIP 16824 system, on body A 2 f or. The location of this facility was given by an Unregistered Comms Beacon that can be found in the HR 1188 system, orbiting body A 2. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

An Unregistered Comms Beacon can be found in the Caucuma system, orbiting body 10 d. The transmission times of this beacon are believed to be on the hour, every 3 hours, with transmissions reported at: 00:00 / 03:00 / 06:00 / 09:00 / 12:00 / 15:00 / 18:00 / 21:00. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Cave Johnson Memorial Science Lab, is a Lowell Class Science Vessel. A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. A Ship Log Uplink point can be located on the hull. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There are several varieties of Chalice Pod to be found around the galaxy - notably in the Acheron sector. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. They, the Quadripartite Pod and Rhizome Pod are the only Pods to have no known 'Tree' associated. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

Located in the Sadr Region Sector PD-S b4-2 system, orbiting body 2, a memorial can be found. Upon scanning the Listening Post, the memorial reads: We of the Pilot's Federation light this beacon on the fringes of human space for the fallen. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

This is a crashed Anaconda on Charon in Sol. This persistent crash is marked as "Human Signal ". On the ground around the wreck are a number of cargo racks that can be shot or cut open with a Maverick Suit and a few manufactured materials for engineering. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Clark's Rest is a point of interest on in the Alshat system on body A 6 b or. The site was found through surface POI scanning, it is unknown whether there are any Listening Posts that reveal its location. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Extremophile organisms that have evolved to create hard shield structures, primarily to protect against stellar radiation. They also collect and condense traces of liquid material in the atmosphere, allowing the organisms to flourish in extremely arid environments. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The crashed Cobra Mk III of ill-fated CMDR John Jameson can be found in the HIP 12099 system, on body 1 b or. The ship - bearing the ship ID JJ-386 - is partially embedded in the crash site, and delivers the following scan data: …High concentrations of mycoid particle detected… That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

CMDR Marxanthius was the first to complete the Canonn Challenge in its orginal form, a voyage of 500,000 light years. He has kindly shared his diary with us. Now the Canonn Challenge has a few more things to see and we have managed to cut down the route by 80,000 lightyears. That is from the Canonn research archive, under the news.

Cmdr Panpiper presents this fascinating insight into these intriguing life-forms commonly referred to as Brain Trees. They can be found on rocky, rocky/ice and ice worlds with ejecta craters also exhibiting volcanism with a temperature range of 200k to 470k. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The Cobra MkIII is a small ship manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy. It was designed as a true multipurpose ship, being able to hold its own in combat, carry a reasonable sized payload for its size, and light enough with large enough internals to jump far. That is from the Canonn research archive, under technology.

An Unregistered Comms Beacon can be found in the Cochi system, near body 1 and Issigonis Gateway. The transmission times of this beacon are believed to be on the hour, every 4 hours, with transmissions reported at: 00:00 / 04:00 / 08:00 / 12:00 / 16:00 / 20:00. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

An Unnamed Crash Site can be found in the Col 285 Sector OP-L b9-0 system on body A 1. As of August 3306 this site does not seem to exist, and scanning the listening posts does not give any messages. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

There are several varieties of Collared Pods to be found around the galaxy - they can be found in the same sector as the human bubble, so are relatively easy to visit. They appear inside Notable Stellar Phenomena. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The Collionson Class Asteroid Ship is a type of Asteroid Miner. Note: Your ship's navigation system may display the Collionson Class Asteroid Ship with two different spellings, "Collionson" and "Collinson", depending on where the megaship is targeted. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

A wrecked Type 9 can be found in the Colonia system, on body 5 e a Some of its cargo of Brewer Corp boxes and Caine-Massey crates sprawled out behind it. Until August 3307 the area was considered a trespass zone, and was guarded by a Goliath; local System Defence Force ships also occasionally patrol the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Colony Site BNI-87 is an abandoned settlement in the Wregoe TJ-Z d6 system on body B 1 or. This site was first reported by Commander Viaharo. The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: Wredguia EB-M c21-11 / Wredguia KC-K c22-1 / Wredguia EB-F d11-37 That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The location of this site can be found by following the two nearby listening posts located in: Wregoe IJ-M b22-0 / NGC 2632 Sector IW-W c1-0 That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: HR 1185 / HIP 17892 / Pleiades Sector PD-S b4-0 That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: Pulano / Col 285 Sector KO-E b26-3 / HIP 97146 That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Communication Hub Zeta 12 is an installation that can be found in the Electra system, orbiting body 4. The installation is designated as a Communication Hub, however, use caution when dropping out of supercruise, as you will often immediately collide with the structure. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Highly specialised complex extremophiles that have developed protective and sturdy motile shell structures. These open and close based on the suitability of the current environmental conditions. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

The transmission times of this beacon are believed to be on the hour, every 4 hours, with transmissions reported at: 00:00 / 04:00 / 08:00 / 12:00 / 16:00 / 20:00. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Occasionally people will research the ancient star maps looking for star systems that may have had different names back in the 21st Century so that the can go visit them. That is from the Canonn research archive, under exploration.

A crashed Thargoid Scout can be found on HIP 17125 body A 3 a, located or. The crash site is surrounded by Thargoid Technology Samples, Thargoid Biological Matter, and Thargoid Resin. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

A crashed Thargoid Scout can be found on Pleiades Sector LN-T c3-4 body 2 a, located or. The crash site is surrounded by Thargoid Technology Samples, Thargoid Biological Matter, and Thargoid Resin. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

The first Crashed Thargoid Ship to be discovered can be found on Pleiades Sector AB-W b2-4 body 9 a, located or. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

The third Crashed Thargoid Ship can be found on HIP 17403 body A 4 a, located or. It was discovered by following the clues beginning at the Sol, Achenar, and Gateway Numbers Beacons and specifically the Unregistered Comms Beacon at the San Tu Scientific Installation. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

Crowther's Rest is an abandoned settlement in the Nervir system on body A 2 a or. You can also use the Detailed Surface Scanner to find this surface location. There is a single settlement uplink and common engineering materials can be found around the settlement. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

These structures are created by colonies of micro-organisms and are found in several sectors. including Sanguineous Rim and The Abyss, mostly around the outer edge of the galaxy. That is from the Canonn research archive, under biology and geology.

An Unauthorised Installation can be found in orbit of Dain A 1. Contains a Navigation Beacon. The number and type of ships around the area is typical for the system's primary Navigation Beacon. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

Dav's Hope is an abandoned settlement in the Hyades Sector DR-V c2-23 system on body A 5 or. The location of this site can be found by following the three nearby listening posts located in: Col 285 Sector MY-O b7-2 / Col 285 Sector GN-H b11-0 / Pic Tok That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

This is a set of locations for the different lore in the Decrypting the Guardian Logs mission. Combinations may also occur at other sites - but if a Lore entry requires Orb + Relic then you can scan that at any instance of the same site layout for the same lore. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

A Galnet article titled "The Hunt for the Dedicant" was posted on 20 July 3309 that pointed to a distress call from the Dedicant megaship detected in the LP 714-58 system. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

A "Distress Call" signal source can be found in the Delphi system, orbiting body 6. Delphi was previously known as Pleiades Sector IR-W d1-55. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The ship is heavily damaged, destroyed by weapons consistent with other Thargoid attacks, leaving green hull scarring and some kind of green gas throughout the area. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Demeter-class Cropper is a class of Agricultural Vessel. The class consists of a long central superstructure with a command module at the front, a rotating dual habitat ring behind it, followed by four rows of three agricultural domes, and a single-engine drive module. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

At 17:01 on the 18th December 3306 the Canonn alert server received a message from the ship of Commander Stronzini informing us that the FSS Scanner had detected a Threat 0 Non Human Signal source in Musca Dark Region PJ-P b6-1. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

Dionysus Class Agricultural Vessel AIE Anzac Honour is a megaship orbiting Pleiades Sector GW-W c1-15 11 which appears to have been added as a result of a Community Goal for Angeli Imperial Enterprises announced in galnet on 15 DEC 3303. That is from the Canonn research archive, under civilisation.

The Dionysus Class Agricultural Vessel designation DSL-327 is expected to be in the following system, based on the last reported flight operations plan: A number of Engineer Materials are scattered nearby, and a number of ships are in the area. Laws were based not on individual rights but on the responsibility of the individual to the community, and each Guardian enforced and followed these laws. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

They swiftly domesticated animals for food, and had a remarkable understanding of inherited traits. That is from the Canonn research archive, under xenology.

The Guardians were a highly intelligent race and mastered a number of technologies.
